items.title: ECLIPSE-Class Starfighter
items.shortDesc: The most advanced Jewerlian airframe, integrating Aetherium power, molecular fabrication, and adaptive flight control.
items.fullDesc: ECLIPSE (Experimental Combat Liaison Intercept, Precision Strike, & Evacuation) is the pinnacle of Jewerlian aerospace engineering. Designed for air-to-air and air-to-ground supremacy. Powered by the AREX-V4 Aetherium Core with VTOL capability, stealth, and kinetic shielding. The integrated Litho Forge enables real-time ammunition fabrication and autonomous self-repair. The Authority Maneuver System allows for extreme maneuvers impossible for conventional aircraft. Equipped with the most advanced anti-creature weaponry.

patches.notes: Prototype assembly complete. Initial flight tests scheduled for Q3.
AREX-V4 Aetherium Core successfully integrated and tested.

patchNotes.notes: Tenth amendment — added Pantry Continuity clause.

items.title: Pillar Doctrine Review
items.shortDesc: Quietly-shelved Board review on whether to recertify Solar's Lens for any future engagement.
items.fullDesc:
The Pillar Doctrine Review was opened by the Board of Trustees to formally evaluate whether Solar's Lens should be recertified for future engagement against Singularity-class entities. The review was placed on indefinite hold after the second session.

[L5+ track=field]Internal minutes (sealed): the review stalled because no member of the Board was willing to be the one to formally request Sola's consent. The matter has not been raised again. The Lens remains in standing orbit, uncrewed, uncertified for new use.[/L5+]

patches.notes: Review placed on indefinite hold pending operator availability.

patchNotes.notes: Predecessor program closed; results migrated to Aethon.

items.title: Pantry Continuity Initiative
items.shortDesc: Logistics-led standing supply program to keep every shift fully provisioned with sealed Secret boxes.
items.fullDesc:
The Pantry Continuity Initiative is the Logistics Division's standing program to ensure that every shift, in every Morneven facility, is fully provisioned with sealed Secret boxes (chicken-drum) in accordance with the Negotiation Protocol.

The project sounds light. It is not. A failed handoff during the Year of Lanterns produced a Step-Forward Signal alert that turned out to be Sola's response to a snack shortage rather than an actual catastrophe - but the resulting evacuation cost the Institute approximately three days of continental productivity. The Initiative now operates with the same uptime targets as the Violet Veil.

patches.notes: Box rotation cycle reduced from 8h to 6h. Zero stockouts in current quarter.
Mechanic Bay 11 added to priority distribution tier.

items.title: Project SOLSTICE
items.shortDesc: Registry and beam-vector mapping of every known Heliograph Spire on Gemora.
items.fullDesc:
Project SOLSTICE is the Mechanic Division's standing registry of all known Heliograph Spires - the Catalyst-class crystal towers that capture violet-dawn refraction and release it as collimated daily energy beams. Each registered Spire is mapped, vector-charted, and integrated into the Violet Veil grid as an off-grid power relay.

The project's secondary mandate is hazard prevention: unregistered Spires have been responsible for two flash-vaporization incidents involving unbriefed handlers. SOLSTICE survey teams are dispatched the moment a candidate plateau is reported.

patches.notes: Registry now contains 312 confirmed Spires across 41 plateaus.
Beam-vector overlay integrated into standard field HUD.

items.title: Genesis Protocol
items.shortDesc: Terraforming barren zones of Gemora using modified Jewerlian biotech to restore ecosystems.
items.fullDesc:
The Genesis Protocol is an ambitious terraforming initiative that seeks to restore life to the Scorched Wastes - vast barren zones created during the apocalypse. Using modified Jewerlian biological technology combined with Worldshard energy, the project aims to accelerate ecological recovery.

Early simulations show a 73% success rate for grassland restoration within a 5-year timeline.

patchNotes.notes: Containment baffles upgraded to GEC Mark II spec.

items.text: Marine sighting reported off the Coral Reach
items.body:
A confirmed Marine sighting was logged at 14:22 by Logistics Patrol 03 along the outer Coral Reach. The Core Figure surfaced briefly to escort a supply caravan past a reef formation, then returned to the deep without further interaction.

Logistics has filed a standard appreciation note. No follow-up is required. Personnel are reminded that approach is not solicited and visit attempts must not be coordinated through duty channels.

The Executive Board has scheduled the annual review of the Amethys Frame, the standing civilizational-scale contingency model authored by Ameth. Three of seven branches will be inspected in this cycle. Two branches remain non-reviewable in the absence of the author.

Attendance is restricted to L4 Executive and above. Field and Mechanic representation may be requested by branch as needed.

skills.name: Amethys Frame
skills.description:
“True victory is achieved through logistical precision, not chaotic violence.”

Ameth excels natively in macro-level calculations, data processing, and logistical deployment. This allows her to coordinate cross-discipline operations and command complex battlefield telemetry seamlessly. Any tactical plan or technological device operated under her direct guidance receives increased efficiency, ensuring minimal casualties and flawless execution. However, processing her high-density tactical demands inflicts a minor [[attr:mental-effect]] strain on her allies' neural links.

skills.name: Structural Subversion
skills.description:
“No system is flawless. I am simply accelerating your inevitable collapse.”

Utilizing her PL6-GOV clearance and deep intellectual backbone, Ameth forces a calculated breakdown in the enemy's formation or localized tech systems. By exploiting minor structural flaws that only her maximum perception can detect, she inflicts a massive temporary debuff to the enemy's [[attr:physical-defense]] and speed, disrupting their combat synergy while exposing their absolute blind spots to her allies.

skills.name: Predictive Synthesis
skills.description:
“Every variable has been accounted for. Your next move was decided decades ago.”

Ameth’s mind constantly runs simulations of the battlefield based on her pre-war strategic frameworks. Whenever an enemy initiates an attack, this skill automatically calculates their trajectory and intent. It grants Ameth a permanent bonus to evasion against [[attr:physical-damage]] and allows her to redirect allied positioning just before an impact occurs, effectively turning enemy aggression into a tactical blunder.

skills.name: Concurrent Mindscape
skills.description:
“The mind is no longer a single path, but an endless expanse of synchronized thoughts.”

This skill allows Ameth to fracture her consciousness into multiple independent, fully functional thought streams without experiencing cognitive overload. Within this mental sanctuary, Ameth can process complex combat telemetry, predict enemy trajectories, and formulate multi-layered strategies simultaneously. To an outsider, Ameth appears completely calm, but inside their mind, an entire council of strategic calculations is executing at light speed. this skill also makes Ameth [[attr:immune]] to any [[attr:mental-effect]] debuff effect.

However, directing such massive cognitive power inward temporarily desynchronizes her physical reflexes, causing her agility to decrease during activation.

items.shortDesc: Jewerlian Core Figure. Founding 'President' of Morneven turned Advisor. PL6-GOV.
items.fullDesc:
Ameth is the Jewerlian Core Figure most associated with Morneven's intellectual backbone. She was the pioneering organizer of the Institute and served as its first 'President', a title she accepted only long enough to stabilize the founding charter, and then handed off. Sitting in a chair of authority bored her; research did not.

Jewerlian society has no caste and no hierarchy. They simply follow specific reliable individuals, the ones Morneven documentation classifies as 'Core Jewerlians.' Ameth is one of them, and her contribution during the Dark Times was structural: she designed the resilience plans that allowed the civilization to survive, and authored the strategic frame for the War of Light that kept casualties at the lowest figure any post-war analyst has been able to model.

She currently holds PL6-GOV clearance, which she uses almost exclusively to wander into laboratories and divisions that interest her on a given day. She is approachable. Be warned, however: ask Ameth a question, and the answer will be technically correct, exhaustively complete, and not at all easy to parse on the first pass.

[L4+ track=executive]Ameth's pre-war contingency models, internally referenced as the 'Amethys Frame' (formerly catalogued as 'Ameth Frame' before being renamed in her honor), remain the Institute's standing reference for civilizational-scale threat planning. The Amethys Frame is structured into seven branches; three have never been activated, and two cannot, by current understanding, be activated by anyone other than Ameth herself. The naming change was ratified administratively to prevent confusion with the author's name and to match the gemstone-derived convention used across other Core-authored doctrines.[/L4+]

skills.name: Telepathic Dislocation
skills.description:
“Distance is merely a flaw in your perception. I am already there.”

Manipulating the spatial coordinates within her telepathic web, Diana instantly teleports herself, a chosen ally, or a designated object to any location within her perception range. This translocation bypasses all physical obstacles, leaving behind a minor [[attr:mental-effect]] distortion that disorients nearby enemies at the arrival point.

skills.name: Sovereign Observation
skills.description:
“I see you. Not just where you stand, but where your breath will falter next.”

Diana opens her eyes, unleashing a supreme telepathic scan that pierces through all battlefield anomalies, illusions, and stealth. For a duration, all hidden threats are exposed, and Diana completely maps out enemy vulnerabilities using her immense perception. This absolute vision shatters the targets' [[attr:mental-defense]] and ensures that all subsequent attacks from Diana or her allies cannot be evaded, turning her high combat power into unavoidable execution.

skills.name: Telepathic Hub
skills.description:
“I am the beacon that guides them home. I hear everything, and so do you.”

Diana natively functions as the central telepathic network for Jewerlians, broadcasting real-time battlefield telemetry and weapon trajectories. This synchronization drastically amplifies her allies' combat efficiency and overall [[attr:mental-defense]]. However, maintaining this high-potency strike network forces a minor [[attr:mental-effect]] strain on non-Jewerlian minds who attempt to process the raw, unfiltered wave of thoughts.

skills.name: Spatial Enclosure
skills.description:
“Do not fear the dark. Inside this space, I dictate who is protected and who is undone.”

Diana deploys an indestructible, transparent telepathic barrier that functions based on her target. When cast on an ally or herself, it acts as an absolute sanctuary, granting full [[attr:immune]] to all incoming damage and status debuffs. When cast on an enemy, it isolates them from the battlefield and rapidly collapses inward, crushing the threat inside its own pocket to inflict colossal [[attr:physical-damage]] that bypasses any active [[attr:shield]].

skills.name: Immovable Stance
skills.description:
“The world may fracture around me, but I remain unchanged until I choose to depart.”

As the Embodiment of Immovable, Diana is highly resistant to being forced out of her position by enemy attacks. When occupying a space, she anchors herself with absolute focus. Whenever an enemy inflicts [[attr:physical-damage]] on her, Diana instantly retaliates with a heavy telepathic counter-cleave using her greatsword, crushing the attacker's defense without needing to take a single step forward.

dislikes: Threats to those under her watch

items.shortDesc: Jewerlian Core Figure. Telepathic Hub of the Jewerlian Chamber. The Embodiment of Immovable.
items.fullDesc:
Diana holds the position immediately after Sola among the Core Figures, and she is, in the most literal sense, silent. She is almost always found in the Jewerlian Chamber, a hall of massive pillars crowned with a single resonant crystal that responds to her, which legend holds to be part of her body. She stands at the center of the great altar, day and night, regardless of weather or season, serving as a guiding signal for Jewerlians who have not yet arrived at Gemora, helping them find their way to Morneven.

Diana is widely assumed to be a defensive type, and she is, but her offense is unconventional. Where most defenders pull allies away from danger, Diana isolates the threat itself and crushes it inside its own pocket. Field personnel have learned not to offend her by accident. They have also learned that she is, when undisturbed, extraordinarily gentle: there are repeated reports of children entering the Chamber unsupervised and being treated with a kindness that has turned the location into what the locals now call 'the safest place in Gemora.' Families visit because the children play there. Diana, as a result, is not always alone.

She serves as the Jewerlian Telepathic Hub. Her catalogued abilities include transparent, indestructible barriers and the teleportation of herself or any chosen object or subject. Doctrine pairs her with Sola as an opposing constant: Sola is the Embodiment of Unstoppable, Diana is the Embodiment of Immovable. They share one trait: when either of them moves with intent, something significant is occurring.

It should be noted that because Jewerlians have the ability to share information, personnel are expected to be cautious when interacting with them, as information spreads rapidly through their network.

She carries a great sword at all times. Analysts believe it functions as a focusing catalyst rather than a weapon. Her eyes are closed for the majority of every observation, but she is recorded to open them when something genuinely catches her attention, or simply for the sake of looking. She holds no PL clearance and has never requested one. Morneven receives her without challenge; she arrives by teleporting into whichever room she chooses. Her arrival is itself the message.

[L4+]Approved Chamber-experiment protocol: any test on Diana's barrier system requires her direct, unambiguous consent given on-site. No proxy authorization is valid. To date, three barrier-stress experiments have been authorized; all three concluded when Diana, without comment, dismissed the apparatus.[/L4+]

items.shortDesc: Adopted Figure. Litho Forge specialist sustained by a shard of Sola's accumulated energy. PL6-ENG.
items.fullDesc:
Era is not a Jewerlian. The Jewerlians consider her family regardless. She was originally an ordinary girl whose hometown was destroyed in a stampede; Sola found her in the ruins in critical condition and brought her back to Morneven personally. Sola's affection for Era is documented and unmistakable, though the reason has never been explained, and no one - including Sora - has pressed the question.

Era's condition deteriorated sharply during a period when Sola was away on a scouting deployment. To this day, it is Sola who functions as the vital support for Era's continued existence. Ameth intervened with a high-risk, unprecedented surgical procedure; the operation succeeded beyond projection. Era recovered, and emerged with molecular-manipulation abilities reminiscent of Sola's, though her control is constrained to a single material: Litho Forge.

The persistent rumor - neither confirmed nor denied at the executive level - is that Era was given a 'Shard' of Sola. Jewerlian physiology accumulates unspent energy in the chest cavity as a dense condensation that is often, incorrectly, assumed to be a heart. The rumor holds that Sola requested this shard transfer herself.

Era holds PL6-ENG clearance. Her ability to shape Litho Forge - Morneven's primary structural and weaponized resource - makes her contribution to the Engineering track effectively foundational. A great deal about her remains under active research and validation. The Institute does not rush this work.

[L5+ track=executive]Era-Sola dependency advisory: any operation that would separate Era from Sola for longer than the established interval requires direct executive sign-off and a contingency protocol filed in advance. The interval is not published in the standard clearance matrix.[/L5+]

skills.name: Geo-Material Core
skills.description:
“Formed in deep quiet, hardened by presence.”

Garnet natively commands an unbounded mastery over geo-materials and crystalline structures. This innate affinity allows her to reinforce any physical structures, armaments, or biological constructs with dense mineral plating. Any defensive barriers or tectonic operations managed under her direct presence receive a massive enhancement to their durability, cementing her status as the most reliable field commander.

skills.name: Observant Silence
skills.description:
“Speak only when your strike can silence the opposition completely.”

Garnet enters a state of absolute silence, actively listening and analyzing enemy combat patterns. During this brief observation window, she becomes [[attr:immune]] to any [[attr:mental-effect]] or crowd-control debuffs. Immediately after, her next basic strike with her red mineral greatsword is guaranteed to critically bypass the target's active [[attr:shield]], converting her quiet focus into fatal execution.

skills.name: Mineral Realignment
skills.description:
“The earth answers to me, with or without a blade.”

Striking the ground or utilizing her mineral-manipulation envelope, Garnet reshapes the geo-materials underneath her targets. Spikes of compacted red mineral erupt instantly, breaking enemy formations to inflict heavy [[attr:physical-damage]]. The shattered battlefield debris then crystallizes around the survivors, trapping them in place and reducing their movement capabilities.

skills.name: Absolute Engagement
skills.description:
“Under my watch, everyone comes home. No exceptions.”

Garnet’s famously calm demeanor and peerless leadership ensure zero casualties during deployments. While she is active on the battlefield, all squad members receive a permanent bonus to [[attr:physical-defense]] and [[attr:magic-defense]]. Furthermore, any lethal damage that would otherwise defeat an ally is automatically mitigated, leaving them with temporary [[attr:shield]] instead.

items.shortDesc: Jewerlian Core Figure. Quiet squad-leader and geo-material specialist with PL4-OPS clearance.
items.fullDesc:
Garnet is one of the twelve Jewerlian Core Figures. Her demeanor is famously calm - sometimes overwhelmingly so. Conversations with Garnet often consist of a 'yes,' a 'no,' or a long, considered silence; none of it is unfriendly. She is, by every account, easy to talk to as long as you do not need her to fill the air for you.

Her ability is the manipulation of geo-materials and minerals. She wields a sword forged from compacted red mineral, though combat doctrine notes she does not actually require a weapon - she simply likes swords. Despite her quiet nature, Garnet enjoys being around others and most often takes the role of listener.

She holds PL4-OPS clearance. The level is modest on paper, but her standing among Jewerlians and field personnel is not. The clearance was issued because Garnet routinely visits training fields to observe drills and assist instructors, not by mandate or appointment. When she leads a squad - which she does often - she is regarded as one of the most reliable field commanders the Institute has ever fielded.

[L3+ track=field]Garnet's mineral-manipulation envelope has never been formally bounded; field tests are halted whenever instructors feel they are 'imposing.' Squads under her command have a recorded mission-success rate of 100% across logged operations. No casualty has ever been attributed to a Garnet-led engagement.[/L3+]

data.shortDesc: Development of the Aethon propulsion system for interstellar travel within the Gemora system.
data.fullDesc:
Project Aethon is Morneven Institute's flagship research initiative focused on developing a revolutionary propulsion system capable of navigating the volatile energy fields of Gemora. The project combines ancient Jewerlian crystal resonance technology with modern human engineering principles to create a hybrid drive system.

The Aethon Drive operates by harmonizing leyline energy currents with controlled antimatter reactions, producing a stable warp envelope that can traverse the dangerous Void Rifts between planetary systems.

patches.notes: Stabilized crystal harmonic frequency output. Reduced energy bleed by 34%.
Integrated failsafe protocols for Void Rift navigation.

Kael Vorthane is a Shadow-kin Demi-human who serves as the primary field operative and tactical advisor for Morneven Institute. Born in the Underdark Territories, he was recruited at age 16 after single-handedly neutralizing a Voidborn scouting party.

His Shadow-kin heritage grants him enhanced night vision, shadow-step capabilities, and an innate resistance to psychic intrusion. Despite his cold exterior, Kael is fiercely loyal to Director Elynra and the Institute's mission.

[L3+]Sealed dossier: Kael's recruitment file documents three deniable operations conducted prior to formal enlistment, including the Vael-Tarn extraction (acknowledged casualties: 0; unacknowledged: 11). His shadow-step ceiling is currently rated at 42 m unassisted, with rig-augmented reach to 110 m. Standing kill-list authorization extends to all DL-4 entities without prior Director approval.[/L3+]
